concept.title: Medical records and care plans
concept.shortdesc: keeps a medical history for every animal and builds a care plan from your shelter's protocols, so nothing is missed.

conbody.p: When an animal is taken in, applies your shelter's intake protocol and creates a care plan: a list of vaccinations, treatments and checks with due dates. Staff see what's due on the Today dashboard and in the app.

ul.li: Vaccinations, with product, lot number and who gave them
Exams and test results, such as heartworm and FIV/FeLV

section.title: Medical holds
section.p: A vet can place an animal on Medical hold. While the hold is in place, the animal can't be listed for adoption or moved to a foster home. The hold ends when a vet clears it.
